title: Velvety Norwegian Olive Paella
description: A rich and creamy Norwegian dish featuring olives, cooked to perfection in a paella pan, with a velvety texture and buttery flavor, this ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly recipe is sure to impress.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced olives and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the warm vegetable broth, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to absorb before adding the next.
After 20 minutes of cooking, stir in the melted butter and grated Norwegian cheese.
Continue cooking for an additional 5 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the paella pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
